description: Phase 15 evaluation application: what the source cannot say. The loyalty consumer receives at-least-once deliveries; business rules for invitations, carts, wishlists, environments, release channels, routes, aliases, the loyalty ledger and two non-negative counters; and the read-your-writes promise of the two nickname entries. Rules whose meaning depends on NULL equality (documents, pages), the admin-count rule and the per-call grant rule are deliberately not declared.

src/services/loyalty.ts#applyLoyaltyEven.description: Message-bus consumer: a message is redelivered after a crash or a lost acknowledgment; deliveries of the same message may overlap.
